notes.title: If you got resolution or controller problems with the game check this post
notes.notes:
[b]For controller problems go ahead to step #4. 

 If you open the game and see that resolution doesn't fit like in the images below please follow this guide. [/b]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31103311/f73c97009fe37bd63603aeacc9c8e2fdceb38371.jpg[/img][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31103311/388c3335b881397d13920f3cc3512fb07b182d99.jpg[/img]

[h1] 1. Check  your system resolution [/h1]

On your desktop, right click and then select display settings. There check your resolution and write it down. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31103311/982aa219a165f79353f8789bf2124bd1c05a589a.png[/img]

Please check if this resolution has a 16:9 aspect ratio, as [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/733870/King_of_the_Eggs/]  King Of The Eggs[/url] only support this aspect ratio. 

Please refer to this site to check if your current resolution is supported: [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/16:9#Common_resolutions]  16:9 Resolution List [/url]

If your resolution is not supported please select one of the 16:9 resolutions that fits your system. We do recommend Full HD (1920x1080) or HD (1280x720) depending on your system.


[h1] 2. Set the resolution on the game [/h1]

Now please go to the Steam app and search for [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/733870/King_of_the_Eggs/]  King Of The Eggs[/url]. Then right click it and select properties and then select[b] "Set Launch Options"[/b]. 

There you will paste the following code, using the custom resolution you chose on step 1.  Then click Ok.
[code] -screen-width 1920 -screen-height 1080  [/code]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31103311/a36586d1cb1957aaef9538c462fde6ab7fd68032.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31103311/c76d523a953ed2d08ba2059e25d20dbadfee64e0.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31103311/817de5da4093ef2792fe9fe551d62e13a3f88a44.png[/img]
[h1] 3. Enjoy the game [/h1]

Now you're ready to go! Enjoy!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31103311/af6b579281a9016ecee8d5c5cf99083462f74bea.png[/img]

[h1] 4. Controller Recommendations [/h1]

We do recommend using Xbox Controllers for playing this game as they enhance the experience. How ever if you do have any problem in game with the controllers please close the game, disconnect every controller, open the game and then connect each controller one by one. 

Enjoy! :)
